svg.title: Musashi Ken — The Drawn Blade. Draft 3 / Musashi Ken classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 9 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Drawn Steel forks into Single Stroke then Cut of No Return, or Second Sword then Two Heavens as One. Reading the Field forks into Unbroken Guard then Victory in the Sheath, or Answering Cut. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Musashi Ken jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

BUFF","adverse":false,"base":1.0,"gain":0,"final":1.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Victory in the Sheath"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Nine nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on six rows (Increase Damage Given x3, Damage x2, Decrease Damage Taken x1); Iaijutsu's move row is unsupported. Drawn Steel forks into a damage route (+6 with Reading the Field, the two-row Damage guardrail) and a tempo route (+6 on three self rows that add). Decrease Damage Taken is one row, so Reading the Field runs a single guard chain (35\u219245%, the Taiyo Kami +10 shape) plus one leaf, Answering Cut (Damage +2). A fourth Advanced Art would twin the Damage or tempo capstone on the same rows and open a second path to that tag's maximum, or push guard past +10. The leaf gives the guard side a 4 BP build without Drawn Steel, so no node is in every build. Three distinct complete builds (Burst, Tempo, Guard), each with two fourth-purchase choices.","design_notes":["Node split: 2 Foundations, 4 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts. Drawn Steel (IDG +2) forks into Single Stroke \u2192 Cut of No Return (Damage +2/+3) and Second Sword \u2192 Two Heavens as One (IDG +2, then IDG +2 with DDT +2). Reading the Field (DDT +2, Damage +1) carries Unbroken Guard \u2192 Victory in the Sheath (DDT +3, then DDT +5 with IDG +2) and the leaf Answering Cut (Damage +2). Every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; two cost 5 BP under the shared root or 6 BP across roots.","Reference reuse: the Damage route (+2, +3) and guard chain (+3, then +5 with a +2 secondary) copy Taiyo Kami's Crown of Cinders \u2192 Solar Cataclysm and Golden Mantle \u2192 Sovereign Sun nearly verbatim; it fits because Heiho's DDT is one 35% row like Taiyo's and the strikes take the same +5 power route. Departures: a single-tag IDG root (no IDT rows), an IDG chain for Afterburn's, Damage +1 on the guard root (no DDG rows), IDG +2 not +3 on the guard capstone (three rows), and the Answering Cut leaf.","Flats by coverage: Damage reaches two 38-power rows, so the route totals +6 (38\u219244), the two-row +6 Lycanthropy uses (Loup-Garou and Dai Kenja reach +6 on one row). IDG reaches three self rows that add and is held to +6 (35\u219241%), between Taiyo Kami's two-row +5 and the two-row +7 of Lycanthropy and Tenohira Musei but row-weighted 18 to their 10 and 14, so +5 (Second Sword +1) is the default unless +6 is explicitly accepted. DDT is one row at +10 (35\u219245%), the Golden Mantle shape.","Interactions: every supported row is element-less. The Bukijutsu filter on Heiho's and Iaijutsu's IDG is not binding: it matches every element-less hit of any stat type (weapons, basic attacks, non-elemental jutsu) and excludes only elemental Nin/Gen/Tai hits; Iaido's IDG and Heiho's DDT list all four stat types and match every non-pierce hit. Each adds power/100 \u00d7 the staged base per hit; the 15% Bukijutsu IDG passive is bloodline-sourced and multiplies in its own stage. Pierce is untouched.","Delivery and uptime: Heiho (40 AP self cast, cooldown 5) is live 2 of every 5 rounds; Iaido and Iaijutsu are 60 AP, cooldown 7. Iaijutsu's IDG row is target SELF and lands on the caster at cast time whatever the circle or move row. No row acts in its cast round: Heiho plus Iaido (100 AP) are live the next two rounds, so an Iaijutsu strike in the first of them gets +70% of staged base (+82% on Tempo) and the round after all three are live (+105%, +123%).","Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) adds Reading the Field (strikes 44, guard 37%) or Second Sword (strikes 43, buffs 39%); Tempo (01,04,05) adds Reading the Field (guard 39%) or Single Stroke (strikes 40); Guard (06,07,08) adds Drawn Steel (buffs 39%) or Answering Cut (strikes 41). 8 of 12 full builds non-dominated (01,04,06,07 loses to Guard, 01,02,06,09 to Burst, 01,02,06,07 and 01,06,07,09 to 06,07,08,09). Row-weighted: Tempo and Guard 24, opener-free Guard 22, Burst 20\u201322, low 17 (Taiyo 31)."],"risks":["Classification: no row carries an element, so the tree needs the proposed bloodline-keyed label (Musashi Ken); under the current resolver all 6 supported rows fall back to None, which also reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts. Whether NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT jutsu collide is unverified (no non-bloodline catalog with effect rows in the repository).","Broad self amplification (user-owned): Two Heavens as One puts each IDG row at 41%. Heiho plus Iaido cast together are live the next two rounds (+12 over 70% of staged base); Iaijutsu cast in the first makes three live the round after (+18 over 105%) on every non-pierce element-less hit. Row-weighted 18 (peers 10\u201314). Default +5 (Second Sword +1) unless +6 is explicitly accepted; +7 heavier.","Iaijutsu delivery: the Damage row is INHERIT on an EMPTY_GROUND circle, friendly fire ENEMIES, so only enemies are hit; the IDG row is target SELF and lands on the caster at cast time (actions.ts 980-1004), not through the tiles, so it is neither positional nor shared with allies or enemies. Only the unsupported move row is positional (sorts last; enemy hazard) and no node touches it.","Answering Cut twins Single Stroke's tag and flat (Damage +2 on both strikes): 01,04,06,09 and 01,06,07,09 give the same bonuses as 01,02,04,06 and 01,02,06,07. It cannot exceed +2 without a second path to +6 Damage; an IDG leaf would open one to +6 IDG and any DDT leaf breaches +10. Dropping it restores a universal Drawn Steel and a fixed Guard build (user option).","Guard is one row at 40% uptime: Victory in the Sheath puts Heiho's DDT at 45% for the 2 rounds after each cast (cooldown 5) against every non-pierce hit. Other DDT sources add to it; it runs against the bloodline's 5% IDT passive, which reaches every non-pierce hit except elemental Bukijutsu hits and no node changes. +8 (capstone +3) is the lighter alternative to Taiyo Kami's +10.","Burst is the lighter route by design: Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling); the 15% passive multiplies the hit and each IDG row live from an earlier round adds its percentage of the staged base, so +6 power also raises what the tempo buffs add. Both strikes are 60 AP, cooldown 7, one hit per cast. Cut of No Return (+3 on two rows) stays single-tag so Burst does not borrow guard.","Unsupported rows and modes: Iaijutsu's move receives nothing; the bloodline passives (15% Bukijutsu IDG, 5% IDT, sealprevent) are not jutsu rows. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP / sparring at the pin. No hidden, item-gated, mode-restricted, adverse or ally-hazard rows exist in this kit."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":9,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":9,"4":12},"full_budget_allocations":12,"non_dominated_full_allocations":8,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":6,"decreasedamagetaken":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":6,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":3},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 3 / Musashi Ken classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Musashi Ken jutsu inherit Musashi Ken potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":4}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":6,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","02","06","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":6,"decreasedamagetaken":4}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","04","06","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":10}},{"ids":["01","06","07","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["06","07","08","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":10}}]}

g.text: Draft 3 / Musashi Ken classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Musashi Ken jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Cut of No Return path + Reading the Field
Two Heavens as One path + Reading the Field
Victory in the Sheath path + Drawn Steel
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
12 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
